name: Auto-compact window cap
summary: Caps the context size at which Claude Code compacts automatically (autoCompactWindow: 300000), so long sessions don't pay for very large contexts on every turn. Risk: more compactions.

evidence.setting: self-controlled context management in a research agent, not this setting
evidence.effect: mechanism: earlier context control lowers per-turn cost (inference for Claude Code)

killTest.hypothesis: A lower auto-compact window lowers cost on long tasks
killTest.pass: One arm (200k or 300k) has a cost-ratio interval below 0.95 and is non-inferior
killTest.budget: 10 tasks that exceed 200k tokens x 3 arms x 2 runs

revisit: a change to the default window
